script_text: Aquarius, brace yourself—this week is a cosmic rollercoaster with Saturn shaking up your foundations. Early week, Mercury squares your ruling planet Uranus on Monday, creating mental tension and unexpected news in your 4th House of home. Tuesday brings a Venus-Neptune conjunction in your 5th House, ideal for creative projects but risky for financial speculation. Wednesday is your power day as the Sun trines Jupiter in your 11th House—perfect for networking and group activities. Mid-week, Mars enters your 7th House Thursday, igniting passion but also potential conflicts in partnerships. Late week, Friday's Full Moon in your 1st House brings emotional revelations and a chance to reset personal goals. Saturday's Mercury-Neptune sextile softens communication, making it great for heart-to-heart talks. Sunday's Saturn-Uranus quincunx may force you to balance tradition with innovation. Best day: Wednesday for social success. Worst day: Thursday for relationship tensions. This week, ground yourself with daily meditation to handle the cosmic chaos. Follow for daily updates.
